title: finding(scripts): `check-lint-coverage.mjs`'s roster comment names `check-action-forward-parity.mjs` as still carrying the closing-keyword shape — PR objectui#9755 removes it there, so the sentence lands false
body:
Created by PR objectui#9755 (card objectui#9597), and reported by the lane that created it rather than left for a reader to trip over.

## What

`scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs:114`–`:120` explains why its DEBT ratchet no longer spells a closing keyword in front of its anchor, and ends by scoping what it did not touch:

```
// The landed precedent is the rule-2
// stale-entry message in scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs; the same
// shape still stands in scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs and
// scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs, which this change deliberately does
// not reach.
```

**The `check-action-forward-parity.mjs` half of that sentence is false once PR objectui#9755 lands.** That PR repairs both of that gate's stale-entry ratchets onto the same settled form, so the shape no longer stands there.

The `check-type-check-coverage.mjs` half remains true, and is owned by objectui#9598 Part 1.

## Why it was not repaired in the PR that falsified it

⛔ Deliberate, and the reason is mechanical rather than stylistic: that sentence sits **inside the region** `scripts/__tests__/check-lint-coverage-closing-keyword.test.ts` slices and asserts on (`text.slice(start, end)` at `:78`). Editing it from a card scoped to a different gate would pull a second gate's verification surface into a scope-pinned diff — which this lane rules against, and which is how the class got its reputation for spreading.

⇒ The cheapest home is objectui#9598's pull request, which touches exactly these files anyway.

## Cost

Small and specific: a reader auditing this class is told, by the most authoritative comment on it, that a site still carries the shape when it no longer does. That sends them to re-verify a repaired file and — worse — implies the roster of remaining sites is longer than it is, which is the kind of error that makes a class look unfinished after it is finished.

## ⚠️ Adjacent, recorded here rather than filed separately because the tree already rules on it

`scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` carries one more instance of the class at its `CLAIM_DEBT` ratchet — `(and close #${CLAIM_DEBT_ISSUE} once the ledger is empty)`, bare anchor. **It is already known and already ruled**: `:878`–`:880` records *"⚠️ `CLAIM_DEBT_ISSUE` a few screens down has the same defect — objectui#4592 is closed while its block is still live — and is deliberately NOT changed here"*. Measured in this act: `CLAIM_DEBT_ISSUE` is **4592**, and objectui#4592 is **closed/completed** ⇒ the trigger is inert today.

⭐ What the tree does **not** record is the re-arm: the ratchet is reachable (`CLAIM_DEBT` holds entries), so if that ledger is ever re-anchored to an **open** card, the trigger goes live again silently — there is no gate between "re-anchor the ledger" and "the emitted message becomes a card-ending quote". ⛔ Not filed as its own card, because the site and its deliberateness are already on the record; recorded here so whoever re-anchors it meets the consequence.

## Not measured

⛔ Whether any other comment in the repository names `check-action-forward-parity.mjs` as still carrying the shape — only the `check-lint-coverage.mjs` sentence was read. ⛔ Whether `check-type-check-coverage.mjs`'s sites are still as that sentence describes them; objectui#9598 Part 1 owns that reading.
